1.title: فطروس — Fotros
1.subtitle: E-commerce Front-End · Personal Project
1.description: An e-commerce interface built with React and Vite, focused on realistic shopping flows and responsive UI.

caseStudy.intro: Fotros is a complete e-commerce interface built with React and Vite, focused on implementing realistic online shopping flows. The project includes product browsing, product details and variations, cart, wishlist, user account, and dashboard features. Reusable components and a structured React architecture were used to build and manage the different parts of the interface. The UI was developed with Tailwind CSS and supports Light, Dark, and System themes. The store data is simulated using a Mock API, and the main features have been fully tested and are ready to use.
caseStudy.role: My Role: Front-End Development, UI Implementation, and implementation of core e-commerce flows
caseStudy.challenge: The goal was to build an e-commerce interface beyond simple product display and implement realistic shopping flows, from product selection and variations to cart, wishlist, and user account features.
caseStudy.solution: I built the store interface with React using reusable components and structured state management for different parts of the application. Store data was simulated with a Mock API, while the responsive UI was developed with Tailwind CSS. Light, Dark, and System themes were also implemented.
technicalBullets: Implemented the e-commerce store interface with React and Vite
Implemented product, product variations, cart, wishlist, and user account features
Designed reusable components and structured the project
Connected the interface to a Mock API to simulate store data
Implemented responsive design with Tailwind CSS
Implemented Light, Dark, and System themes
Tested and reviewed the functionality of the project's main sections

5.title: پیدا — Peyda
5.subtitle: E-commerce / WooCommerce · Personal Business Project
5.description: A real e-commerce store for practical home and kitchen products, built and customized with WordPress and WooCommerce.

caseStudy.intro: Peyda is a real e-commerce store for practical home and kitchen products, built and customized for my own business. The store is based on the Marketyar theme. I handled the customization of the homepage, About and Contact pages, product content and images, store structure, and WooCommerce settings. I also handled the practical setup required to launch the store, including obtaining the eNAMAD trust seal, tax code, and setting up the payment gateway.
caseStudy.challenge: The goal was to build a real e-commerce store for a small business, allowing users to browse products, find what they need, access their account, and place orders. Alongside the visual design, the page structure and shopping flow also needed to be customized to the business requirements.
caseStudy.solution: I built the store structure with WordPress and WooCommerce and customized the UI based on the business requirements and visual identity. I implemented the main store pages, product and category pages, user account, cart, and checkout, and configured the ordering and payment flow based on the store's requirements. I also focused on responsive layouts, the user journey throughout the shopping process, and making the store manageable for everyday use by the business owner.
technicalBullets: Customized the Marketyar theme and store interface
Implemented and configured WooCommerce features
Fully prepared product and category content
Set up cart, user account, checkout, and order placement
Set up the payment gateway, eNAMAD trust seal, and tax code
Prepared and tested the store for real-world use

6.title: مارکت یار — Marketyar
6.subtitle: WordPress E-commerce Theme · Team & Commercial Project
6.description: A commercial e-commerce theme for WordPress and Elementor, developed as a team project.

caseStudy.intro: Marketyar is a commercial e-commerce theme for WordPress and Elementor, developed as a team project. I was responsible for designing the UI, creating and preparing content, implementing the front-end, and contributing to different parts of the theme. I also defined and coordinated team tasks and helped align team members to move development forward.
caseStudy.role: UI Design, Front-End Development & Team Coordination
caseStudy.challenge: The goal was to develop and complete a commercial e-commerce theme for WordPress and Elementor, providing a range of features within a structured and reusable system. One of the main challenges was coordinating different development areas and dividing features among team members to keep parallel development organized and avoid conflicts.
caseStudy.solution: I worked with the existing WordPress and PHP codebase and contributed to different front-end areas and theme features. Alongside development, I prepared product and publishing content and coordinated the team by defining, assigning, and tracking tasks across different parts of the project.
technicalBullets: Developed and customized various sections of the WordPress/Elementor e-commerce theme
Implemented and developed store UI and different theme pages
Worked with 29 Elementor widgets and a range of theme features
Supported multiple product display structures and store layouts
Used Ajax in areas like the product archive for faster user interaction
Implemented and customized theme headers, mega menu, and footers
Contributed to features such as SMS login, search, cart, Q&A, and product comparison
Worked with RTL structures and the Persian user interface
Worked with the existing WordPress/PHP codebase and developed features based on project patterns
Defined, divided, and tracked team members' tasks and coordinated development progress

7.title: MVP
7.subtitle: Client Project / MVP
7.description: A client MVP focused on UI redesign and front-end development, from an AI-assisted initial concept to the final interface.

caseStudy.intro: This project was created based on a client's requirements, with the initial UI concept generated using AI tools. I redesigned the interface based on my front-end experience and implemented the final version.
caseStudy.challenge: The initial UI concept was created with the help of AI tools, but it needed further refinement to achieve a more consistent and usable interface. The main challenge was turning the initial concept into a practical, structured, and implementable interface following front-end practices.
caseStudy.solution: I redesigned the initial interface and improved the visual structure, layout, and details of its different sections. I then implemented the final interface based on the project requirements, focusing on creating a consistent and usable result in both visual design and front-end structure.
technicalBullets: Redesigned the initial interface and improved the visual structure
Turned the initial concept into a responsive, implementable interface
Implemented the front-end based on project requirements
Improved layout, visual hierarchy, and interface details
Collaborated with Alireza to prepare the final version of the project
